sources.snippet: Jogg-Avatar V2V is an audio-driven avatar video generation model based on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B. The Jogg-Avatar V2V checkpoint is available on Hugging Face. Given a source video and a driving audio track, it preserves body, camera, and background motion while regenerating the face region with synchronized speech.
